gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Paprika is loud and expressive, its lowercase swelling to fill the line like capitals. And Noto Sans Old Persian sits beneath in sans-serif, contemporary and tall, its open counters letting the white space in.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Noto Sans Old Sogdian has a tall x-height that nearly reaches cap height, with wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk. Paprika supplies the swagger above it.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Paprika scatters its letters at a distance and lets its lowercase stand as tall as capitals, commanding and expressive. Noto Sans Old Turkic keeps things plain sans and chunky.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Contemporary and approachable, Noto Sans Oriya keeps generous gaps in its curves and small letters nearly as tall as its capitals. Paprika above it is the showy one, commanding.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-osage: Big, inflated bowls and sweeping curves that never close up. Paprika fills the line like capitals, and Noto Sans Osage follows as a plain sans, approachable and businesslike.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Paprika is all command, a display face with expressive scattered letters. Noto Sans Osmanya, a plain sans, takes over for longer reading, its s shapes turning wide and easy while the lowercase looks oversized beside its capitals.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong sets a high x-height and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, neutral and contemporary in feel. Under Paprika's loud display, a plain sans like this would read steadily.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Loud, scattered letters with hollow counters like a cut reed make Paprika the showpiece, with Noto Sans Palmyrene beneath it. Its curves stop short and its ascenders stay compressed, so a plain sans this clean reads smoothly.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Paprika's lowercase fills the line like capitals, widely spaced and commanding. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau is the modern sans below, with open-ended curves and little step up to its capitals.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Noto Sans PhagsPa reads contemporary and approachable, with c openings you can see through and a gentle bump up to capitals. Paprika is best at commanding display, while this sans-serif handles the body.
